1. (Currently amended) A method for generating a superframe preamble for a superframe, the superframe preamble comprising a plurality of symbols, in an orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) network, comprising: for a first one of the symbols, allocating a first set of subcarriers of a carrier to a first broadcast channel, the first set of subcarriers __distributed over substantially the entire carrier in a manner that differs from a second set of subcarriers__; and for the first one of the symbols, allocating the second set of subcarriers of the carrier to a second broadcast channel, __wherein the first set of subcarriers and the second set of subcarriers are allocated to different broadcast channels within the same symbol__.

2. (Currently amended) The method as set forth in Claim 1, the first set of subcarriers distributed uniformly over substantially the entire carrier __while the second set of subcarriers is distributed non-uniformly or in a complementary pattern__.

3. (Currently amended) The method as set forth in Claim 1, the first set of subcarriers distributed non-uniformly over substantially the entire carrier, according to a pre-determined pattern __that is distinct from the distribution pattern of the second set of subcarriers__.

4. (Currently amended) The method as set forth in Claim 1, the second set of subcarriers distributed over substantially the entire carrier __in a pattern that is different from the first set of subcarriers__.
